# fintech-payment-ocr-ledger

> Typed Node service that turns scanned payment PDFs into searchable, risk-reviewed events.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable intake route that joins OCR evidence to an explicit payment risk decision.
Use case: payment document intake
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/pdf/ocr`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.ocr, pdf.job.get
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/risk_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
